name: Momotype
source:
The monotype, an off-shoot virtual pet, is being play-tested by members of your company. You have been selected.

An experimental, retro take on tamogotchi-lite games. Will you fulfill Momo's needs or does he need something greater?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你所在的公司正在安排员工试玩一款名为Monotype的新型虚拟宠物，而你被选中了。

这是一款带有实验性质、走复古路线的轻量电子宠物游戏。你能满足Momo的需求吗？还是说，他想要的远不止这些？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822190/]Steam[/url]]
